'''The Jet's Hole''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Kuwemaki]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[Hera Tani]]'''.<ref name="inara-jets-hole">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52289/ The Jet's Hole in Kuwemaki — Station], Inara.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Kuwemaki]]
* '''Body:''' Kuwemaki A 3 a
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-jets-hole" />

== Engineer ==

The Jet's Hole is operated by '''[[Hera Tani]]'''. Hera is reached through a referral from [[Liz Ryder]] — see [[Hera Tani]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access her workshop.

== Station Services ==

The Jet's Hole offers a commodity market, outfitting, rearmament, refuelling, repairs, shipyard services, and a black market, in addition to Hera's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-jets-hole" />
